# Barlow Condensed

The self-hosted regular heading font is Barlow Condensed by Jeremy Tribby,
distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The unmodified license is in
[`LICENSE`](LICENSE); the font is in `static/fonts/barlow-condensed-regular.ttf`.

Source: [Google Fonts, pinned revision](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/5bb28733cec313b63fbd415b574b5ae35c8aa8b8/ofl/barlowcondensed).
The upstream file is `BarlowCondensed-Regular.ttf`; only its filename is changed.

Font SHA-256: `583cec5da3b84bc4dc7c9c72e2a565c94d34e431518b19d7e250b7830ad5f996`.
